objective: Bring exact G3 scripted-expert replays with two right-arm bowl operations under the frozen 1200-frame task horizon without relaxing the horizon or any success or safety rule.

single_control_variable.name: right_rrt_attached_bowl_transport_duration_s
single_control_variable.rationale: The runner records and accepts a two-second transport contract but silently hard-codes four seconds only for right-arm attached-bowl RRT execution. Removing the hard-coded override makes right and left transport honor the same frozen contract and saves 60 policy frames per right-arm transport at 30 Hz.
unchanged: RRT planner, path nodes, smoothing curve, endpoints, and collision checking
source resets, side assignment, grasp candidates, candidate order, and replay plans
IK, controller gains, force limits, geometry, safety checks, placement feedback, release, retreat, and stability checks
capture, export, training, and learned-policy behavior

downstream_policy.accepted_terminal_action: Promote only the two-second right attached-bowl transport component, then combine it later with separately accepted components.
downstream_policy.rejected_terminal_action: Retain the four-second production baseline and attribute exact failing stage spans before testing another timing variable.

increase the task horizon or relax safety, success, placement, contact, tracking, or stability thresholds
change path geometry, planner parameters, endpoints, candidate selection, or another duration
capture, export, collect, train, retry, or replace a panel seed
